title: man tasked
subtitle: Two hand-ins, in order, and a long description
description: The long-description quest, and on a green-on-black palette a page of prose is what
the theme was designed for, which is worth saying plainly because it is the opposite
of what you would expect from the least Minecraft-looking theme in the set.
The section headings are the brightest green and the body is a mid one, so on this
chapter TASKS and REWARDS are more prominent than the text under them -- the reverse
of every other theme. That is a real trade and it is visible here and nowhere else.
Scroll down for REQUIRES: a green tick and a grey-green cross. All four states in
this theme are greens of different brightness, with the one exception of the
in-progress amber, which is the only colour on the canvas that is not green.
The scrollbar's thumb is a mid green on a very dark track, which on this canvas is
unmistakable. Compare it with Copper's, where the same two tokens are deliberately
quiet: the scrollbar tokens exist precisely so that a theme can make that choice
As in every chapter, this paragraph exists to make the body taller than the clip.
